The long green stalks appear to merge into each other and the background slightly, lacking clear individual definition at their bases. Some edges look soft or melted.
The straight line of the cutting edge shows very slight waviness or inconsistency in sharpness, which could be a minor geometric artifact or just depth-of-field blur, but warrants checking.

To verify the boundary between the metal blade and the handle, ensuring no fusion artifacts exist at the tang connection.
To analyze the texture realism of the meat and vegetables, checking for the 'smudged' or 'painted' look common in AI food generation.
To ensure the cleaver sits correctly on the board plane and doesn't float or clip through the wood surface.
